name: Carnegie Mellon University
character: The campus features two perpendicular grassy areas, The Cut and The Mall, surrounded by Beaux-Arts buildings with green Spanish tile roofs and International Style structures.

landmarks.name: The Cut
landmarks.quote: A large grassy area known as "The Cut" forms the backbone of the campus
landmarks.look: Large grassy area forming a central campus backbone.

landmarks.name: The Mall
landmarks.quote: with a separate grassy area known as "The Mall" running perpendicular.
landmarks.look: Grassy area running perpendicular to The Cut.

landmarks.name: Cohon University Center
landmarks.quote: re-dedicated the University Center as the Cohon University Center

landmarks.name: Gates Hillman Complex
landmarks.quote: The Gates Hillman Complex opened for occupancy on August 7, 2009.
landmarks.look: Large academic complex with offices, labs, and classrooms.

landmarks.name: Randy Pausch Memorial Footbridge
landmarks.quote: connected by the Randy Pausch Memorial Footbridge.

landmarks.name: Tepper Quadrangle
landmarks.quote: develop the Tepper Quadrangle on the north campus.
landmarks.look: North campus quadrangle with a business school and welcome center.

landmarks.name: College of Fine Arts building
landmarks.quote: a nearby hill that was leveled to build the College of Fine Arts building.

landmarks.name: Walking to the Sky
landmarks.quote: donated the 80-foot (24 m)-tall sculpture Walking to the Sky
landmarks.look: Tall 80-foot sculpture standing on a lawn.
